name: Salesforce Data Export

account.personcontactid.note: An Account is a person account when PersonContactId is populated; that Id is the account's system-managed Contact.

_notes: Auto-applied when an extract has Account, Contact and User tables with Salesforce system columns. Salesforce's Data Export writes 000000000000000AAA into empty lookup fields; it is treated as blank everywhere. Person accounts are identified by a populated Account.PersonContactId.
